prompt_text: Who is the best roofer in Denver for hail damage repair?
ai_overview_text:
Top-rated roofing companies in Denver for hail damage repair include Home Genius Exteriors, Cenco Roofing, Metro City Roofing, and Premier Roofing. Premier Roofing Company +3
Highlights: Rated as a top overall choice with a limited lifetime labor warranty that transfers to a new buyer, Owens Corning Platinum Preferred contractor status, and experience with comprehensive exterior storm repairs (siding, gutters, and windows).
Cost Range: Typical hail damage roof repair or replacement in Colorado ranges from $1,800 to $9,000 depending on the size and severity of the damage. Modernize Home Services
Insurance Coordination: Most major hail repairs involve an insurance claim; reputable local contractors will handle line-item damage reports and walk through the scope with your adjuster. coreroofing.com +1
Shingle Upgrades: Many Denver homeowners choose Class 4 impact-resistant shingles to reduce future storm bruising and qualify for potential insurance discounts. Premier Roofing Company +1
Inspection: Most trusted local roofers offer free 30-to-45-minute roof and flashing inspections to document granule loss and impact marks. metrocityroofing.com +1
